post.description: Exchanges master or downline agent credentials for a scoped Bearer JWT token (~20–25 minute lifetime). Re-mint immediately if response contains HTML challenge.

post.summary: Live Bet Ticker Feed (Delta Watermark Stream)
post.description: Ticket-per-row continuous surveillance stream. Supports delta polling using monotonic wagerNumber watermark. Ingests all 5 active WagerSource channels: Internet (L18.N0204), ALERT (L21.N0884), GSBUILDER (L22.N1402), GSLIVE (L23.N0412), CSLEVEL2 (L24.N2019).

wagerNumber.description: Monotonic watermark integer ('0' for full initial batch)

post.description: Probes if the live bet ticker is configured for the authenticated agent scope. Returns { 'INFO': false } when inactive or misconfigured.

Returns raw flat array of ~6,000+ open legs. Requires client-side parent ticket reconstruction keyed by Login|WagerNumber. Drops BLOCKED sentinel noise (L19.N0518) and zero-stake rows prior to parent grouping.

200.description: Flat array of pending wager legs

post.summary: Forensic Web Access Log & IP Tracker (Observed HAR Capture v1.0.279)
post.description: The authoritative forensic IP investigation endpoint documented in operational_guardrails_runbook.md § 5.1.1. Governed by the selector type field: A (Web Access Log velocity), B (Global IP Matcher across BILLY666 downline), C (Acct IP Match for sibling accounts), I (Users by IP reverse lookup).

customerID.description: 0 for whole book; target bettor ID for Mode C

start.description: Start date (MM/DD/YYYY, or YYYY-MM-DD for Mode C)

end.description: End date (MM/DD/YYYY, or YYYY-MM-DD for Mode C)

type.description: A: Web Access Log; B: Global IP Matcher; C: Acct IP Match; I: Users by IP

ip.description: Target IP address or /24 prefix for Mode I

post.description: Searches both downline agent tree nodes and bettor customer accounts. Employs autocomplete='new-password' to defeat password manager autofill.

post.summary: Customer State Mutation (Confirmation Delays & Limit Clamps)
post.description: Mutates single column on customer record. Invariants: customerID must be strictly 11-character space-padded PaddedCustomerId. agentID/agentOwner must match direct owning sub-agent (never master BILLY666). Passing path poisons updateByColumn (HTTP 500 empty body).

Result.description: 1 = SUCCESS (Committed); 0 = FAILURE (Unpadded bare ID / silent drop); -1 = REJECTED_SCOPE (Master BILLY666 passed)

400.description: Model error (Called Customer/updateByColumn instead of Manager/)

500.description: Poisoned path parameter detected (empty body) or Gateway fault

post.description: Reads live customer record to verify persistence following updateByColumn mutations via normalized Bun.deepEquals().

post.summary: Player Odds Shading & Vig Override Mutation (+15c / +20c)
post.description: Applies custom vigorish adjustments to sharp accounts (+15c main spreads/totals, +20c derivatives). Requires Content-Type: application/json, 20-character space-padded sportType, and 11-character space-padded player ID.

post.summary: Read-Back Verification for Player Vig Overrides
post.description: Queries live vigorish configuration to verify persistence following vigSetupInsert mutations.
Feeds mobile and desktop header summary tiles: My Balance, Weekly figure, Today net, Active accounts, and Makeup carryover deficit.
Triggered by data-action='get-weekly-figure'. Returns Monday-to-Sunday weekly volume, gross net won/lost, and active account totals across all sub-agents under BILLY666.

200.description: Weekly settlement figures across downline branches

post.description: Triggered by data-action='get-agent-performance' (data-type='C'). Downline volume, net won, and hold percentage evaluated against the 8-tier BranchGrade hierarchy (AAA down to D_TOXIC).
Triggered by data-action='get-settled-figure' (Collections). Audits weekly settled figures, agent 50% split accounting, and carryover makeup obligations.
Triggered by data-action='delete-wager'. Audits all voided, cancelled, and deleted tickets to investigate line-chase cancels or VOID_HEAVY_DISGUST churn.

200.description: List of deleted and voided tickets

get.description: Local in-process probe verifying Bun HTTP server uptime, active port, and runtime environment.
Returns list of tracked accounts under active surveillance. Requires SPORTSDESK_ADMIN_TOKEN bearer authorization.

post.description: Dispatches an urgent formatted rich alert message directly to the desk Telegram channel via @demodevdeskbot.
Immediately triggers and broadcasts one of the three scheduled reports: MORNING_BRIEFING (08:00 EDT), MIDDAY_STEAM (13:00 EDT), or EVENING_SETTLEMENT (23:00 EDT).
Provisions authenticated desk operator session. Sets RFC 6265 HTTP-only cookie desk_session_id using sequential UUIDv7 timestamps.

Set-Cookie.description: desk_session_id cookie with 8-hour operator shift lifetime and sameSite=strict

delete.description: Clears desk_session_id cookie and invalidates session token.

post.description: Executes Tier 2 limit raises or sharp overrides requiring cryptographic operator authorization. Validates DESK-* HMAC token using constant-time crypto.timingSafeEqual before dispatching Manager/updateByColumn.

403.description: Invalid token or unsafe referrer policy detected

post.summary: GS Buckeye 2 Partner 118 Steam Reference Ingestion
post.description: Asynchronously queries Partner 118 getBetReport to resolve cross-book steam moves joined via M.G<betGroupId>. Mandates referrerPolicy: 'strict-origin'.

data-win.description: Raw unformatted to-win amount in dollars

Risk.description: Parent ticket risk repeated on every leg row
